rules.label: WAF-HDR-001
rules.description: X-Forwarded-For is not a comma-separated list of IP addresses. Catches log poisoning and injection smuggled through XFF.
rules.notes: No decoding transformations on purpose; header must be well-formed as sent.

rules.label: WAF-HDR-002
rules.description: First X-Forwarded-For value claims a loopback, private or link-local address (IP allowlist bypass attempt).
rules.notes: Assumes nginx is the first hop. Re-scope if a trusted load balancer is added in front.

rules.label: WAF-SQLI-001
rules.description: UNION-based, time-based (sleep/benchmark/pg_sleep/waitfor), file access (load_file/outfile) and stacked execution (xp_cmdshell) SQL injection.
rules.notes: Chained: @pm prefilter then @rx. Complements CRS 942xxx with a dedicated WAF label.

rules.label: WAF-XSS-001
rules.description: Script tags, inline event handlers on HTML elements, javascript: URIs, srcdoc attributes.
rules.notes: Chained: @pm prefilter then @rx. DVWA accepts no legitimate HTML input.

rules.label: WAF-RCE-001
rules.description: OS command injection: shell metacharacter or substitution followed by a known binary.
rules.notes: Anchored on the metacharacter so a bare word like cat does not fire. Never exclude ARGS:ip for DVWA.

rules.label: WAF-LFI-001
rules.description: Directory traversal, PHP stream wrappers (php://, phar://, zip://, expect://) and sensitive file names.
rules.notes: Double URL decoding on purpose. normalisePath is not used because it would collapse the .. sequence.

rules.label: WAF-RFI-001
rules.description: Remote URL supplied in a file-type parameter.
rules.notes: Generic url/redirect/next parameters excluded on purpose (SSRF / open redirect handled elsewhere).

rules.label: WAF-CVE-001
rules.description: Log4Shell and Text4Shell: ${jndi: and lookup obfuscations, any nested ${ within 20 chars, script/dns/url prefixes.
rules.notes: Complements CRS 944150; inspects every header including X-Forwarded-For.

rules.label: WAF-CVE-002
rules.description: PHP-CGI argument injection via soft hyphen (%AD) or literal -d / -s in the raw query string.
rules.notes: Raw query string, no decoding, so the %AD encoding is seen as sent. Tag GROOT_A/stack/php.

rules.label: WAF-CVE-003
rules.description: Java expression injection: Spring4Shell classLoader parameter names, Confluence and Struts OGNL.
rules.notes: Tag GROOT_A/stack/java. Can be removed by tag while the backend is PHP-only.
